CLAUDE.md

Source: CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

Shared conventions

The portfolio’s shared rules are synced into .claude/shared/ from pedrobtz/packages:claude/shared/. Never edit them here. Where this file and a shared file disagree, this file wins for this package.

@.claude/shared/workflow.md @.claude/shared/r-package.md @.claude/shared/ci.md @.claude/shared/correctness.md @.claude/shared/assurance.md

This package predates those files and departs from them in a few places. Each departure is stated as one below, in the section it belongs to.

What this is

An R client for the IMF SDMX 3.0 REST API at https://api.imf.org/external/sdmx/3.0. It has two layers: a raw layer (sdmx_structure(), sdmx_data(), sdmx_availability(), sdmx_metadata()) that returns the API response as a nested list (JSON) or text (XML), and a tidy layer (list_datasets(), list_dimensions(), list_dimension_values(), get_data()) that returns tibbles. set_imf_proxy() and clear_imf_proxy() configure an HTTP proxy for the session. Every call goes to the API; nothing is cached between calls.

Deviation from the zero-dependency rule: runtime dependencies are httr2 (>= 1.0.0) and tibble.

There is no design or roadmap document and no .agents/ directory. The exported docs, the two vignettes (getting-started, migration) and the tests are the contract.

Current state

On CRAN as 0.2.0 (published 2026-07-06). main is the development version, 0.2.0.9000, with no changes yet under its NEWS.md heading. Version 0.2.0 replaced the decommissioned IMF JSON API used by 0.1.x with SDMX 3.0, a breaking change; vignettes/migration.Rmd maps the old functions to the new ones.

Gaps from the shared rules, as of 2026-11-11:

  • CI is not yet on pedrobtz/r-actions: R-CMD-check.yaml is the hand-rolled r-lib template, so it does not count as the pre-submission check. Issue #23 tracks the move, and a coverage workflow with it.
  • No cran-release.yaml; the .9000 bump was a hand-made pull request.
  • No .agents/assurance.md.
  • Errors are plain stop(..., call. = FALSE) and warnings plain warning(), with no condition classes. Tests pin the wording with snapshots instead of asserting on classes.
  • cran-comments.md still lists a local macOS check as its test environment, not CI legs.

Versions and dependents

The current version’s parent issue is #21, v0.2.1. The cran-release reminder is #20. Sibling packages that depend on this one: none.

Commands

The shared commands apply. Specific to this package:

Rscript -e 'lintr::lint_package()'               # as lint.yaml runs it
VCR_RECORD=all Rscript -e 'devtools::test()'     # re-record every cassette

Any lint fails lint.yaml. Re-recording calls the live API.

VCR_RECORD accepts none (the default), once, new_episodes or all. Recording needs network access to the IMF API; review the cassette diff before committing it.

Architecture

Two R files, collated in a fixed order (Collate: in DESCRIPTION): R/sdmx_api.R first, then R/imf_api.R.

  • R/sdmx_api.R, the raw layer. Argument validators (validate_scalar_character(), validate_choice(), validate_period(), validate_rfc3339(), validate_filters() and the proxy validators), the request builder sdmx_request() and sdmx_perform(). sdmx_request() sets the Accept header, the proxy, a imf.data/<version> user agent, a 60-second timeout, three tries with retry on failure, and an error body that surfaces the API’s message. sdmx_send() is the one place a request is performed. sdmx_perform() returns NULL for HTTP 204.
  • R/imf_api.R, the tidy layer. resolve_dsd() follows a dataflow to its data structure definition (two sdmx_structure() calls, with references = "datastructure" then "children"). codelist_labels() turns a codelist into code, name, description. parse_data_message() decodes an SDMX-JSON data message into rows; decode_key(), zero_based_position() and the attribute decoders map the message’s zero-based indices onto dimension and attribute values. Malformed input goes through malformed_response().
  • State. imf_data_state, an environment in R/sdmx_api.R, holds the proxy configuration and nothing else. Credentials stay there; the functions return only proxy_summary(), which redacts them.

Invariants that are easy to break

  • No network during checks. Tests replay vcr cassettes from tests/fixtures/. tests/testthat/setup-vcr.R forces record = "none" whenever _R_CHECK_PACKAGE_NAME_ is set or _R_CHECK_CRAN_INCOMING_ is true, whatever VCR_RECORD says, and a test asserts that an unmatched request fails with vcr_unhandled. cran-comments.md promises CRAN this.
  • Cassettes are matched on method and URI only. A change to the query string a function builds (parameter names, order, the c[DIM] filter syntax, ge:/le: period bounds) breaks replay until the cassette is re-recorded.
  • Proxy credentials never leave the package. set_imf_proxy() and clear_imf_proxy() return the redacted summary, and setup-vcr.R filters authorization and proxy-authorization headers out of cassettes, along with volatile response headers.
  • SDMX-JSON indices are zero-based. Series keys such as "0:1" and observation keys index into the structure’s values lists, and zero_based_position() adds one and rejects anything that is not a non-negative whole number below .Machine$integer.max.
  • Empty results are a warning and a typed empty tibble, not an error. get_data() warns on HTTP 204 and on zero matched observations, and returns a tibble with the expected column types.
  • first_n_obs and last_n_obs exclude each other, and periods must be one of the SDMX forms validate_period() accepts (year, month, date, reporting period, RFC 3339).

Testing

  • tests/testthat/test-sdmx-api.R covers the raw layer and tests/testthat/test-imf-api.R the tidy layer. Each HTTP test wraps its calls in vcr::use_cassette("<name>", ...), with the cassette at tests/fixtures/<name>.yml.
  • tests/testthat/helper-fixtures.R provides fixture_data_response(), a hand-built SDMX-JSON data message (two series, one empty variant) for testing the parser without a cassette.
  • Validation errors are checked with expect_snapshot(error = TRUE, ...), snapshots in tests/testthat/_snaps/. This is a deviation from asserting on condition classes, because the package raises none.
  • The live API is exercised only by live-api-smoke.yaml, never by the test suite.

Continuous integration

None of the workflows call pedrobtz/r-actions yet (see Current state).

  • R-CMD-check.yaml: the r-lib template matrix, macOS and Windows release and Ubuntu devel, release and oldrel-1. No CRAN-like containers.
  • lint.yaml: lintr::lint_package() with LINTR_ERROR_ON_LINT=true, so any lint fails. .lintr allows lines up to 120 characters, CamelCase or snake_case names, and drops return_linter; R/imf_api.R turns off object_usage_linter for the whole file.
  • live-api-smoke.yaml: weekly (Monday 06:17 UTC) and on dispatch, fetches the last two US CPI observations from the live API and checks their shape. It is the only place the real API is called.
  • pkgdown.yaml: the r-lib template, deploying to gh-pages with clean: false. _pkgdown.yml uses development: mode: auto.
